evidence.http_title: HP LaserJet Pro M404dn - Embedded Web Server
evidence.provenance_note: No device was captured. IP and hostname use documentation-only ranges. The model name is based on HP's official LaserJet Pro M404/M405 product and driver page (https://support.hp.com/us-en/drivers/hp-laserjet-pro-m404-m405-series/model/19202535). The PJL value follows HP's documented INFO ID response convention of returning a quoted model name (Printer Job Language Technical Reference Manual, ID Category: https://h10032.www1.hp.com/ctg/Manual/bpl13208.pdf), but this exact M404dn response was not observed. SNMP, HTTP, ports, and HP MAC-vendor values are assumptions, not observations.
